rules.description: Verify all active StatVars meet scoped freshness boundaries (2024 for refreshed series, 2022/2020 for education/vital stats, >= 2009 for historical census).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation', 'Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation_Female', 'Count_Student_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation_Male') THEN MaxDate >= '2022' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_BirthEvent_LiveBirth' THEN MaxDate >= '2020' WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Death|MortalityEvent|BirthEvent|(Student|Person)_KenyaCertificateSecondaryEducation)|(Nominal_|RealValue_|GrowthRate_)?Amount_(Economic|Expenditure)Activity_GrossDomesticProduction)') THEN MaxDate >= '2024' ELSE MaxDate >= '2009' END AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed threshold (0.1%).
